result.answer:
Microsoft operates its business and reports financial performance using three operating segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing [1]. 

For the fiscal year 2026 compared with fiscal year 2025 (periods ending June 30, 2026), Microsoft reported the following financial details:

* **Total Revenue:** $331,839 million in fiscal year 2026 compared to $281,724 million in fiscal year 2025, an increase of 18% [3].
* **Total Cost of Revenue:** $106,374 million in fiscal year 2026 compared to $87,831 million in fiscal year 2025, an increase of 21% [3].
* **Total Operating Expenses:** $70,228 million in fiscal year 2026 compared to $65,365 million in fiscal year 2025, an increase of 7% [3].
* **Total Operating Income:** $155,237 million in fiscal year 2026 compared to $128,528 million in fiscal year 2025, an increase of 21% [3].
* **Productivity and Business Processes Segment:** Revenue increased by $19.2 billion or 16% [3]. Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services revenue increased by $14.2 billion or 16%, with Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud revenue growing 17% [3].
* **More Personal Computing Segment:** Revenue was $54,052 million in fiscal year 2026 compared to $54,649 million in fiscal year 2025 ((1)% change); cost of revenue was $23,481 million compared to $25,238 million ((7)% change); operating expenses were $16,185 million compared to $15,245 million (6% change); and operating income was $14,386 million compared to $14,166 million (2% change) [3].
* **Sales and Marketing Expenses:** Increased by $1.1 billion or 4%, driven by investments in commercial sales and higher Copilot advertising expenses [4].
* **General and Administrative Expenses:** $7,956 million (2% of revenue) in fiscal year 2026 compared to $7,223 million (3% of revenue) in fiscal year 2025, representing a 10% increase [4].

More information about our progress toward these goals can be found in our annual Environmental Sustainability Report.
OPERATING SEGMENTS
We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. Our segments provide management with a comprehensive financial view of our key businesses. The segments enable the alignment of strategies and objectives across the development, sales, marketing, and services organizations, and they provide a framework for timely and rational allocation of resources within businesses.
